audit_items.proof_trace: The property assertion is overly broad. Blob parameters only exist for epochs >= Fulu fork (EIP-7892). The code correctly returns base_digest for pre-Fulu epochs (L590, L612) and XORs blob params only for Fulu+ epochs (L594-610), enabling distinct fork digests for blob-parameter-only (BPO) forks as documented in fork_context.rs:L6-14.
